references.note: Approved disc, lighting and camera; do not copy its creature.
Native species shape: stocky orc in mail armour, single tall staff, no shield.
Shipped catalog humanoid/orc: hammer + shield, gold-trimmed armour. Massok/Krogar must stay distinct from this and from each other.

prompt_fields.subject: A stocky, heavily armoured orc in dull green-grey mail plate, standing solidly with a tall gnarled wooden staff held upright in one hand, the other hand free and clawed. The staff must be held short and close to the body, fully inside the disc: its top end must stay below the top of his head level and well inside the inner four-fifths of the disc radius (a previous attempt had a long staff crossing the disc edge, radius 0.98). No long protruding weapon; compact pose.
prompt_fields.contrast: Fourth humanoid/orc catalog identity alongside golbug (hammer+shield), brotoq (dual axes) and massok (dragon-skull helm+greatsword, shipping in this same handoff group). Krogar carries a single tall staff and no shield or bladed weapon, and wears plainer dull green-grey mail rather than massok's dark green-black plate with a bone helm -- silhouette (single vertical staff, bare-headed, no helm) and value/hue (duller cooler green-grey armour, no pale bone accent) keep it apart from the other three orcs at a glance.
prompt_fields.composition: One compact complete creature on a single circular tabletop disc, steep overhead three-quarter camera; visible clear neutral base ring on every side. Keep all anatomy and equipment well inside the inner four-fifths of disc radius. Base brightness must visually match reference neutral disc, with no illumination spill or ground effects. Disc plate discipline: measured results show generations of this style reference tend to render the disc DARKER than the reference, never lighter. So do not darken the disc at all: render the neutral disc -- including the whole outer-sixth ring band and the area under the creature -- at the style reference's own brightness, if anything a hair lighter, and never darker. No warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette anywhere on the disc. Do not darken the creature to compensate either. Add no warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette to the disc anywhere, including directly under or behind dark-bodied creatures.
prompt_fields.palette: Dull green-grey mail plate armour with darker leather straps, weathered warm-brown wooden staff, olive-green orc skin visible at the face and hands; dry neutral charcoal disc with restrained copper-grey bevel, kept a visibly lighter value than the creature's armour so the two never merge.
